schemes.title: Delhi Lakshmi Yojana (Rs 2,500 a Month for Women)
schemes.department: Department of Women and Child Development, Govt of NCT of Delhi
schemes.brief: Rs 2,500 a month for women aged 21 to 60 from low-income Delhi families. It was announced as the Mahila Samriddhi Yojana and renamed the Delhi Lakshmi Yojana when it started on 1 August 2026. You choose how the money comes: Rs 1,000 a month into a digital rupee (CBDC) wallet to spend and Rs 1,500 into a locked deposit, or the full Rs 2,500 into the deposit. The deposit stays locked till 31 July 2029, and you apply online on the scheme's own portal.
schemes.benefit: Rs 2,500 a month: Rs 1,000 to spend + Rs 1,500 saved, or all Rs 2,500 saved till July 2029
eligibility: Women aged 21 to 60 on the day you apply, who are registered voters in Delhi
Family income of Rs 2.5 lakh a year or less. Only the eldest eligible woman of the family can apply
You, your husband or one of your parents must have lived in Delhi for at least 10 years
Not for income-tax payers, GST filers, women already getting any government pension, or families where anyone is a government employee (regular or contract) or owns a four-wheeler
Family electricity use of 2,400 units a year or less, not more than three living children, and no criminal record
documents: Aadhaar card, plus the Aadhaar and voter ID numbers of every family member above 18
Delhi voter ID card
Proof of 10 years in Delhi (any one): voter ID, ration card, driving licence, or an electricity or gas bill
Age proof (any one): birth certificate, Class 10 certificate, school leaving certificate, PAN, Aadhaar or voter ID
Your photo and signature
Bank account in your name in a listed bank that offers the CBDC wallet (SBI, PNB, Bank of Baroda, Canara, Union, HDFC, ICICI, Axis and others)
APAAR ID of school children aged 3 to 18 and ABHA health ID of family members (the form asks for them)
The application form printed from the portal, signed and stamped by your area MLA or MP

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number of the Applicant
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on your own Aadhaar card. The OTP goes to the mobile number linked with this Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name as per Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Spell your name exactly as it is printed on Aadhaar, or the check will fail.

demoFields.label: Gender
demoFields.hint: Only women can apply, so Female is already chosen.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As written on Aadhaar. You must be between 21 and 60 years old on the day you apply.

demoFields.label: Eligibility questions
demoFields.value: Family income Rs 1,80,000 a year; four-wheeler: No; government job in family: No
demoFields.hint: Answer every question truthfully. A false answer means the money is recovered and legal action is taken.

demoFields.label: Living in Delhi since
demoFields.hint: You, your husband or a parent must have 10 years in Delhi. Keep one old proof, like a voter ID or ration card, ready to upload.

demoFields.label: Family member details
demoFields.hint: Add everyone who shares your kitchen. Give Aadhaar and voter ID of adults and the APAAR ID of children aged 3 to 18.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: Your own account in one of the listed banks with the CBDC wallet facility. If you have none, the partner bank will open one.

demoFields.label: Payment option
demoFields.value: Option 1: Rs 1,000 to CBDC wallet + Rs 1,500 to RD/FD
demoFields.hint: Option 2 puts the whole Rs 2,500 into the deposit, locked till 31 July 2029.

demoFields.label: MP/MLA endorsement
demoFields.value: Signed form uploaded (MLA of the area)
demoFields.hint: After the preview, download the QR-coded form, get it signed and stamped by your area MLA or MP, and upload it.

demoSteps: Open dly.delhi.gov.in and tap Register. Enter your Aadhaar number, name as on Aadhaar, date of birth and the captcha, and verify with the OTP to create your login.
Log in, answer the eligibility questions, then fill your personal details, every family member, your bank account, and the payment option.
Upload Aadhaar, voter ID, 10-year residence proof, age proof, photo and signature. Preview everything and submit.
Download the QR-coded form, get it signed and stamped by your MLA or MP, upload it, and save the acknowledgement slip.
The district Women and Child Development office checks the papers and the district committee approves. You get SMS updates, and Track Application on the portal shows the status by mobile number.

Payment starts from the month after you apply (apply by 31 July, paid from August). Each month Rs 1,000 reaches the CBDC wallet and Rs 1,500 the deposit, or Rs 2,500 the deposit if you chose option 2.
schemes.helpline: 011-23862652 (Director's office, Women and Child Development Dept, Kashmere Gate) / email wcd@nic.in / complaints on cmjansunwai.delhi.gov.in

schemes.title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Delhi (Ayushman / Vay Vandana Card)
schemes.department: Department of Health & Family Welfare, Govt of NCT of Delhi, with the National Health Authority
schemes.brief: Delhi joined Ayushman Bharat in April 2025 and adds its own Rs 5 lakh on top of the Centre's Rs 5 lakh, so eligible families get Rs 10 lakh a year of free, cashless hospital treatment. Every Delhi resident aged 70 or above gets the Vay Vandana card with the same Rs 10 lakh cover, whatever the income. Treatment is at empanelled government and private hospitals, and free OPD care is given at Ayushman Arogya Mandirs. You can make the card yourself on the phone.
schemes.benefit: Rs 10 lakh a year cashless (Rs 5 lakh from the Centre + Rs 5 lakh Delhi top-up)
eligibility: Delhi families found in the National Food Security (ration card) data or the SECC 2011 list, or groups added by the Delhi Cabinet (about 6.5 lakh families)
Every Delhi resident aged 70 or above, whatever the family income, under the Vay Vandana card
No limit on family size or age, and illnesses you already have are covered from day one
Each member needs Aadhaar e-KYC to get a card; the cover is shared by the family
documents: Aadhaar card of the person whose card is being made
Delhi ration card number, to find and link the family
Mobile number for OTP
For the 70+ Vay Vandana card, Aadhaar alone is enough (it shows your age)
A live photo, taken on the phone during e-KYC

demoFields.label: Login as
demoFields.hint: Choose Beneficiary when you are making the card for yourself or your family.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Any working number you hold. The OTP and the approval message come here.

demoFields.label: Scheme and state
demoFields.hint: Choose PMJAY and Delhi. For someone aged 70 or above, use the 70+ (Vay Vandana) option instead; only Aadhaar is needed.

demoFields.label: Search your family by
demoFields.hint: The ration card number finds the whole family at once. You can also search by Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the Delhi ration card. If nothing is found, try your Aadhaar number.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number for e-KYC
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar of the member whose card you are making now. Each member is done one at a time.

demoFields.label: e-KYC method
demoFields.hint: Use OTP if the mobile is linked to Aadhaar, otherwise choose face authentication on the phone camera.

demoFields.label: Live photo
demoFields.hint: Face straight, good light, no cap or dark glasses. A blurred photo gets the request rejected.

demoFields.label: Relation with head of family
demoFields.hint: How this member is related to the person named first on the ration card.

demoFields.label: District and PIN code
demoFields.hint: Where you live now, so nearby empanelled hospitals are shown.

demoSteps: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in or the Ayushman app and log in as Beneficiary with your mobile number and OTP.
Choose PMJAY and Delhi and search by ration card or Aadhaar. For a person aged 70 or above, use the 70+ option with just Aadhaar.
Find the member marked eKYC pending and verify with Aadhaar OTP or face authentication.
Take the live photo, fill the mobile number, relation, district and PIN code, and submit.
Approval usually comes within a day or two by SMS. Log in again and download the card from Download Card.
If it does not work online, take Aadhaar and the ration card to a government dispensary or the Ayushman Mitra desk of an empanelled hospital and get the card made there.
At the hospital, show the card at the Ayushman Mitra desk. Never pay cash for a treatment covered by the scheme.

schemes.title: Delhi Old Age Pension (Financial Assistance to Senior Citizens)
schemes.department: Department of Social Welfare, Govt of NCT of Delhi
schemes.brief: A monthly pension for poor Delhi residents aged 60 and above: Rs 2,000 a month from 60 to 69 (Rs 2,500 for SC, ST and minority applicants) and Rs 2,500 a month from 70 onwards. It is paid every month into your own Aadhaar-linked bank account. You apply on the e-District portal or at the District Social Welfare Office, and new pensions are given only when your assembly constituency's quota has a free slot. The government has proposed raising both rates by Rs 500; until that is notified, these rates apply.
schemes.benefit: Rs 2,000 a month (age 60-69), Rs 2,500 (70+); Rs 500 extra for SC/ST/minority aged 60-69
eligibility: Aged 60 or above
Lived in Delhi for at least 5 years before applying
Yearly income of you and your spouse together below Rs 1 lakh from all sources, including rent and interest
A single-name (not joint) bank account in Delhi, linked to your Aadhaar
Not getting any other pension or financial help from the Centre, Delhi government, MCD, NDMC or anywhere else
documents: Aadhaar card (the online form does not open without it)
Age proof (any one): birth certificate, Class 10 certificate, voter ID, PAN, passport, ration card or Aadhaar
Proof of 5 years in Delhi: old ration card, voter ID, electricity or water bill, bank passbook or similar
Passbook of your single-name bank account in Delhi
One passport-size photo
Income self-declaration in the format given on the portal
SC/ST: caste certificate; minority: religion declaration verified by a religious institution (only for age 60-69)
Recommendation by an MP, MLA or Gazetted Officer, with attested documents

demoFields.label: Service
demoFields.hint: After logging in, open the Social Welfare department's services and pick the old age pension.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Your own Aadhaar. The pension goes to the bank account linked with this number.

demoFields.label: Applicant name / Father's or husband's name
demoFields.value: Kamla Devi / Late Shri Har Prasad
demoFields.hint: Write the name as on Aadhaar and the bank passbook.

demoFields.label: Date of birth
demoFields.hint: Must show you are 60 or above. Upload the age proof that has this date.

demoFields.label: Category
demoFields.hint: SC, ST and minority applicants aged 60 to 69 get Rs 500 more; attach the caste certificate or religion declaration.

demoFields.label: Assembly constituency and address
demoFields.value: Seemapuri / House 41, Block D, Dilshad Colony
demoFields.hint: Pensions are given against each constituency's quota, so choose the right one.

demoFields.label: Living in Delhi since
demoFields.hint: You need at least 5 years. Upload one document that proves it.

demoFields.label: Annual income of applicant and spouse
demoFields.hint: Must be below Rs 1 lakh from all sources together.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: A single-name account in a Delhi branch, seeded with Aadhaar. Joint accounts are not accepted.

demoFields.label: Recommended by
demoFields.hint: An MP, MLA or Gazetted Officer must recommend the form and attest the documents.

demoSteps: Open edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in, register as a new user with Aadhaar and mobile number, and log in.
Choose the Social Welfare service for Old Age Assistance and fill in the form.
Upload age proof, residence proof, bank passbook, photo, income self-declaration and the recommended pages, then submit and note the application number.
The District Social Welfare Office checks the application and may call you with original documents. A decision normally comes within 45 days.
If sanctioned, the pension starts from the month after the month you applied and is credited every month to your Aadhaar-linked account.
Check progress on the Social Welfare website's Online Status of Old Age Pension page. Tell the office within a month if your address or bank changes.
schemes.helpline: 9289550124 (Deputy Director, Financial Assistance Schemes, Social Welfare Dept) / 14567 (Elderline, senior citizens helpline)

schemes.title: Atal Ayushman Uttarakhand Yojana (Ayushman Golden Card)
schemes.department: State Health Authority, Uttarakhand (Medical Health & Family Welfare Department)
schemes.brief: Free, cashless hospital treatment up to Rs 5 lakh a year per family for almost every family in Uttarakhand. Families on the central PM-JAY list are covered by PM-JAY, and the state covers all the other resident families under Atal Ayushman on the same terms, hospitals and packages. The Ayushman (golden) card is made from your ration card or family register, on the phone or at a Jan Seva Kendra (CSC).
schemes.benefit: Rs 5 lakh a year per family, cashless, at empanelled hospitals
eligibility: Uttarakhand families found in any of these lists: NFSA ration card data, the old Mukhyamantri Swasthya Bima Yojana, SECC 2011 or SECC Plus
No income limit and no limit on family size; every member is covered
Not for people covered by CGHS, ECHS, ESIC or the State Government Health Scheme (state employees and pensioners have their own SGHS card)
Illnesses you already have are covered from day one
Atal Ayushman uses a referral system, so planned treatment at a private hospital may first need a referral from a government hospital
documents: Aadhaar card of each member
Family ID: ration card (new or old) or a copy of the family register (Parivar Register)
If you have neither: an ID such as voter ID, birth certificate, permanent residence certificate, PAN or passport showing your father's, mother's or spouse's name
Mobile number for OTP
A live photo taken during e-KYC

demoFields.label: Login as
demoFields.hint: Choose Beneficiary when you make the card for yourself or your family.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Any working number you hold. The OTP and approval message come here.

demoFields.label: Scheme and state
demoFields.hint: Pick Uttarakhand. Atal Ayushman families are on the same Ayushman system, so the search works for both.

demoFields.label: Search your family by
demoFields.hint: The ration card number brings up the whole family. You can also search by Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from your ration card. If your family is not found, try Aadhaar or go to a Jan Seva Kendra.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number for e-KYC
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar of the member whose card you are making. Each member is done separately.

demoFields.label: e-KYC method
demoFields.hint: Good for elderly people whose fingerprints do not scan. Use Aadhaar OTP if the mobile is linked to Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Live photo
demoFields.hint: Face straight, good light, no cap or dark glasses.

demoFields.label: Relation with head of family
demoFields.hint: Relation to the person named first on the ration card.

demoFields.label: District and PIN code
demoFields.hint: Where you live now, so nearby empanelled hospitals are shown.

demoSteps: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in or the Ayushman app and log in as Beneficiary with your mobile number and OTP.
Choose Uttarakhand and search your family by ration card number or Aadhaar.
Pick the member, verify with Aadhaar OTP or face authentication, take the live photo, fill the details and submit.
The State Health Authority approves it, usually within a day or two. Log in again and download the card.
If your name is not found or e-KYC fails, take Aadhaar and the ration card or family register to a Jan Seva Kendra (CSC) or the Arogya Mitra desk of an empanelled hospital.
When you need treatment, get a government hospital referral where required, then show the card at the Arogya Mitra desk. Treatment is cashless.
schemes.helpline: 155368 / 1800-180-5368 (State Health Authority, Uttarakhand) / 14555 (Ayushman Bharat national helpline)

schemes.title: Nanda Gaura Yojana (Rs 11,000 at Birth + Rs 51,000 after Class 12)
schemes.department: Women Empowerment and Child Development Department, Uttarakhand
schemes.brief: Money for daughters of low-income families in Uttarakhand, in two parts: Rs 11,000 when a girl is born in a hospital, and Rs 51,000 when she passes Class 12, joins a degree or diploma course and is unmarried. Up to two living daughters per family can benefit. You apply online on the Nanda Gaura portal, within 6 months of the birth, and by 30 November of the year she passes Class 12. Money is given first come, first served within the yearly budget.
schemes.benefit: Rs 11,000 at birth + Rs 51,000 after Class 12 (Rs 62,000 per daughter)
eligibility: Parents are permanent residents of Uttarakhand
Family income up to Rs 6,000 a month (Rs 72,000 a year), on a Tehsildar's income certificate not older than 1 year
Only two living daughters of a family can get it
Birth stage: born in a hospital or ANM centre, mother registered at the Anganwadi during pregnancy, and the application made within 6 months of birth

Class 12 stage: passed Class 12 from a recognised board or NIOS, admitted to a degree or at least a 1-year diploma, unmarried, name on the family ration card; apply by 30 November of the year she passes
documents: Aadhaar and PAN card of mother and father (and of the girl for the Class 12 stage); a PAN application receipt is accepted
Permanent residence certificate
Income certificate issued by the Tehsildar
Birth certificate and institutional delivery certificate (birth stage)
Anganwadi worker's certificate and MCP (vaccination) card (birth stage)
Class 10 and Class 12 certificates, the principal's certificate and proof of college admission (Class 12 stage)
Ration card copy and family register copy (or a certificate from the councillor)

Bank passbook (joint account of mother and girl for birth, the girl's own for Class 12; Aadhaar-linked, not a Jan Dhan account), with last year's statements of family accounts and the last 3 electricity bills

demoFields.label: Registered mobile number
demoFields.hint: The OTP comes here, and this number becomes your login ID.

demoFields.label: District name
demoFields.hint: Choose the district where the family lives.

demoFields.label: OTP received on mobile
demoFields.hint: Type the code to verify the number before the registration form opens.

demoFields.label: Girl's name
demoFields.hint: Write the daughter's name as on her birth certificate or school records.

demoFields.label: New password / Confirm password
demoFields.hint: Write it down safely. You log in with the mobile number and this password.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar card number
demoFields.hint: The girl's Aadhaar. For a newborn without Aadhaar, the mother's Aadhaar can be entered.

demoFields.label: Block / project
demoFields.hint: The child development project (block) of your area.

demoFields.label: Stage applied for
demoFields.hint: Choose the birth stage within 6 months of birth, or the Class 12 stage after she passes and joins college.

demoFields.label: Monthly family income
demoFields.hint: As written on the Tehsildar's income certificate. It must not be above Rs 6,000 a month.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: Joint account of mother and girl (or the mother's) for birth; the girl's own account for Class 12. Not a Jan Dhan account.

demoSteps: Open nandagaurauk.in, click the new applicant registration link, enter your mobile number and district, and verify with the OTP.
Fill the girl's name, password, Aadhaar and block to register, then log in with the mobile number and password.
Fill the application for the right stage and upload every certificate clearly, each under 200 KB. Submit and note the application number.
The Child Development Project Officer checks the papers, and the district committee chaired by the Chief Development Officer approves eligible cases.
The money is sent by DBT: Rs 11,000 to the joint or mother's account, or Rs 51,000 to the girl's account. If the year's budget runs out, approved girls are paid first the next year.

schemes.title: Uttarakhand Old Age Pension (Vridhavastha Pension)
schemes.brief: Rs 1,500 a month for people aged 60 and above in Uttarakhand who are BPL or whose monthly income is up to Rs 4,000. Husband and wife can both get it if each qualifies. You apply online on the Social Welfare Department's pension portal (eSPAN), and the money is paid into your bank account every three months. About 6 lakh elderly people get it now.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,500 a month, paid every 3 months (June, September, December, March)
eligibility: Aged 60 or above and living in Uttarakhand
From a BPL family, or with monthly income up to Rs 4,000 on a Tehsildar's income certificate
Husband and wife can both receive it if each qualifies
Not getting any other central or state government pension
Bank account in your own name (not a joint or loan account), linked to Aadhaar
documents: BPL certificate, or income certificate from the Tehsildar (monthly income not above Rs 4,000)
Resolution of the Gram Sabha open meeting (in villages)
Copy of the family register (Parivar Register)
Aadhaar card
Passbook of your bank account
Recent photo
Voter ID (its number is asked in the form)
schemes.portalName: Social Security State Portal (eSPAN), Social Welfare Department Uttarakhand

demoFields.label: Scheme
demoFields.hint: Choose the old age pension from the list. The scheme cannot be changed after saving.

demoFields.label: Applicant's name (English and Hindi)
demoFields.hint: Type in English; the portal writes the Hindi itself. It must match Aadhaar and the bank passbook.

demoFields.label: Father's / husband's name
demoFields.hint: As written on your Aadhaar or voter ID.

demoFields.label: Category, date of birth and age
demoFields.hint: Your age must be 60 or more.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Your login ID and password come here by SMS. Give the number linked to Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Years of residence in Uttarakhand
demoFields.hint: How many years you have lived in the state.

demoFields.label: Voter ID and Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Both are required. Tick the box allowing the department to use Aadhaar for the pension.

demoFields.label: District, area type, tehsil, block, panchayat, village
demoFields.value: Pauri Garhwal / Rural / Kotdwar / Dugadda / Sendhikhal / Sendhikhal
demoFields.hint: Fill carefully. These cannot be corrected by you later.

demoFields.label: IFSC and account number
demoFields.hint: Enter each twice. Use your own account linked to Aadhaar, not a joint or loan account.

demoFields.label: BPL ID or income certificate number, date and monthly income
demoFields.hint: Monthly income cannot be more than Rs 4,000, or the form will not accept it.

demoSteps: Open ssp.uk.gov.in, go to Online Application and click New Online Application. Choose Old Age Pension, fill the form, enter the captcha and save.
Your applicant login ID and password come by SMS. Log in through Applicant Login.
Under Upload Documents, upload each document as a PDF under 1 MB, then print the application.
The verifying officers check it and the District Social Welfare Office sanctions it. Follow it under Application Status on the portal.
Once sanctioned, Rs 1,500 a month is paid every quarter (June, September, December, March) into your Aadhaar-linked account. The online pension passbook shows each payment.
schemes.helpline: 1800-180-4236 (toll-free) / 6395221188 (WhatsApp and mobile) / 0135-2669764 (IT cell, Social Welfare Department)
